description: Bærum kommune innbyr til åpen anbudskonkurranse i forbindelse med inngåelse av kontrakt for kjøp av vinterdriftstjenester.Anskaffelsen gjelder inngåelse av kontrakt for kjøp av vinterdriftstjenester ved adkomstvei til Brunkollen i Bærum kommune.Vinterdriftstjenestene omfatter brøyting, strøing og fylling av strøkasser.Kontrakten gjelder fra 01.09.2027 til 31.08.2031 for sesongene 2027/28, 2028/29, 2029/30 og 2030/31 med opsjon på forlengelse én eller flere ganger inntil 2 år for sesongene 2031/32 og 2032/33. Avtalen kan bli på totalt 6 år ved utløsing av full opsjon.Beredskap starter 15. oktober hver sesong. Brøyting og strøing utføres i perioden 15. oktober til 15. april hver sesong. Ytelsen er nærmere beskrevet i vedlegg 1 «Oppdragsgivers kontraktbestemmelser». Det vises til vedlegg 8 «Brøyteareal og brøytekart – Brunkollen» for kart og vedlegg 2 «Prisskjema» for arealer.

title: Konsulent - 430185 Instrumentering av overløp, forprosjekt
description: Trondheim kommune, heretter kalt oppdragsgiver, innbyr til åpen konkurranse om kontrakt i prosjektet " instrumentering av overløp - forprosjekt". Kommunen ønsker tilbud fra leverandører med det faglige, tekniske og økonomiske grunnlag som er nødvendig for oppfylling av kontrakten. Videre kreves erfaring fra tilsvarende arbeider for utførelse av ovennevnte kontraktsarbeid iht. konkurransegrunnlaget.Konkurransen gjennomføres via kommunens konkurransegjennomføringsverktøy Mercell. All kommunikasjon og tilbudsinnlevering skjer via Mercell.

Nærmere informasjon om konkurransen, derunder anskaffelsesprosedyre, konkurranseregler, grunnlag for tilbudet, krav til tilbudet, eventuelle kvalifikasjonskrav, tildelingskriterier mv., er beskrevet i konkurransegrunnlagets del I Konkurransebeskrivelsen med vedlegg.

buyer: Oslo kommune v/ Økonomi- og forvaltningsetaten
title: Rammeavtale for kjøp av mat og drikke - Detaljistavtale
description: Oslo kommune skal inngå en samkjøpsavtale for kjøp og levering av mat- og drikkevarer til kommunens "mindre virksomheter", en detaljistavtale. Felles for mindre virksomheter i kommunen er at lagringsmulighetene for både tørr- kjøl og frysevarer er begrenset og de kjøper ofte mindre forpakninger og antall. Avtalen skal sikre at virksomhetene får tilgang til et hensiktsmessig sortiment, tilpassede forpakninger og en leveringsfrekvens som understøtter deres drift.

title: 2026/3602- Parallelle rammeavtaler for maler – og beleggarbeider i Grenlandsregionen
description: Statsbygg ber om tilbud på parallelle rammeavtaler for maler – og beleggarbeider i Grenlandsregionen Det vil bli inngått parallelle rammeavtaler med 2 av tilbyderne på bakgrunn av denne konkurransen så fremt konkurransen gir grunnlag for det. Planlagt oppstart av avtalen er januar 2027 da eksisterende rammeavtale utløper.

title: Rammeavtale tekniske og medisinske gasser, spesialgasser
description: Oppdragsgiver ønsker å inngå rammeavtale med en leverandør om levering av tekniske og medisinske gasser samt spesialgasser. Oppdragsgiver benytter diverse gasser til mange ulike formål som f.eks. til faste installasjoner/anlegg og utstyr, og til konkrete forskningsprosjekt hvor det kan variere hvilken type gass det er behov for. Det er av avgjørende betydning med stabil og punktlig levering for å unngå store praktiske konsekvenser og økonomiske tap. Med denne anskaffelsen ønsker universitetet å sikre en stabil tilgang på gasser og tilhørende installasjoner til effektive priser.

title: Nettverksutstyr
description: Formål Anskaffelsen er delt i to delkontrakter: Delkontrakt 1 – Nettverksutstyr til Cisco-basert nettverksmiljø: Supplering, fornyelse og livssyklusforvaltning av eksisterende Cisco-basert infrastruktur. Det åpnes for Cisco eller tilsvarende produkter som oppfyller kravene til kompatibilitet og funksjonalitet. Delkontrakt 2 – Helhetlig nettverksplattform: Anskaffelse av en teknologinøytral nettverksplattform med switcher, trådløse aksesspunkter, sentral administrasjon, nødvendige lisenser og produsentstøtte. Brannmur inngår som opsjon.

description: Renhold av kontorlokalene våre i Oslo

title: Kommunenes økonomiske forvaltning av startlån
description: Kommunenes utlån av startlån forvaltes på ulike måter. Husbanken ønsker gjennom dette oppdraget å få mer systematisk og så langt som mulig kvantitativ kunnskap om kommunenes kostnader og inntekter ved administrasjon og forvaltning av ordningen, ulike forvaltningsmodeller og kommunenes økonomiske håndtering av innlånte startlånsmidler. Kunnskapen skal gi Husbanken et bedre grunnlag for å vurdere om dagens økonomiske og administrative rammer fungerer etter hensikten.

title: Rammeavtale plantjenester
description: Statsbygg skal inngå parallelle rammeavtaler om bistand til plantjenester. Oppdragene i rammeavtalen vil være tilknyttet statens eiendommer, behov og prosjekter i hele Norge. Eiendomsmassen Statsbygg forvalter består blant annet av universiteter og høgskoler, tinghus, politihus og fengsler, kulturbygg, tollstasjoner, veg- og trafikkstasjoner og barneverninstitusjoner.

buyer: Oslo kommune v/ Renovasjons- og gjenvinningsetaten
title: Batterielektrisk hjullaster til Bygdøy hageavfallsmottak
description: Oslo kommune har som målsetting en overgang til fossilfrie maskiner. Som del av Renovasjons- og Gjenvinningsetaten (REG) sitt bidrag skal maskinparken byttes ut med nullutslippsteknologi. Nå skal det anskaffes en batterielektrisk hjullaster til vår lokasjon på Bygdøy, og som skal brukes i den daglige driften. Hjullasteren som nå skal anskaffes skal erstatte en eldre 20-tonns diesel hjullaster. Vi har vurdert at en mindre hjullaster er hensiktsmessig (6-10 tonn, egenvekt). Det er ikke et krav om at hjullasteren skal være ny men det følger begrensninger i vedlagte kravspesifikasjon for hva som skal tilbys. Ellers bemerkes det at det er lite strømkapasitet til lading på lokasjonen hvor hjullasteren skal brukes, se kravspesifikasjon. Det vil bli gjennomført prøvekjøring som del av evalueringen. Tilknyttet hjullasteren skal det inngås en løpende service - og reparasjonsavtale. Det vises ellers til vedlagt kravspesifikasjon.

buyer: Oslo kommune v/ Vann- og avløpsetaten
title: Kjøp av nitrogengass for initiering av råtnetanker
description: To råtnetanker på Bekkelaget renseanlegg, råtnetank 3(RT3) og råtnetank 4(RT4), klargjøres for oppstart etter gjennomført reparasjon. Det er viktig før å ta råtnetanker i bruk at oksygen fjernes fra tankene. Dette er nødvendig for å hindre at det oppstår en eksplosiv atmosfære inne i tankene i perioden slam kommer inn og produserer metan mens det fortsatt er luft til stede. Bekkelaget renseanlegg har derfor behov for levering av nitrogengass for initiering av to råtnetanker, RT3 og RT4. Det anslåtte behovet er 15 tonn nitrogengass. Produktet som tilbys, skal oppfylle alle krav som stilles i kravspesifikasjonen. For detaljer – se tilbudsinnbydelsens vedlegg 1 Kravspesifikasjon.

title: Totalentreprise for etablering av multibane 20 x 14 meter
description: Bakgrunn Oppdragsgiver har behov for å etablere en ny multibane fordi dagens uteområde ikke i tilstrekkelig grad dekker aktivitetsbehovet ved skolen og i nærmiljøet. Anskaffelsen skal bidra til å gi elever, barn og unge samt øvrige brukere et robust, tilgjengelig og funksjonelt aktivitetstilbud både i skoletiden og til uorganisert bruk etter skoletid. Multibanen skal være et varig nærmiljøanlegg som legger til rette for variert aktivitet, helårsbruk og trygg bruk over tid. Lokasjonen stiller særlige krav til planlegging og utforming, blant annet på grunn av begrenset plass, nærhet til skolebygg, uteområder, boliger, parkering og vei. Det er derfor viktig med løsninger som ivaretar god adkomst, universell utforming, redusert driftsbehov og hensyn til omgivelsene. Anskaffelsen skal gjennomføres som en totalentreprise for å sikre en helhetlig og effektiv gjennomføring, med tydelig ansvar for prosjektering, utførelse og ferdigstillelse av anlegget. Kontrakten skal baseres på NS 8407, med de forenklinger og særlige bestemmelser som fremgår av eget vedlegg til konkurransegrunnlaget. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget omfatter totalentreprise for prosjektering, levering og etablering av en nøkkelferdig multibane med spilleflate på om lag 20 x 14 meter ved angitt lokasjon. Parkeringsplass ble etablert i 2011. Se vedlegg. Leveransen skal gi oppdragsgiver et komplett og ferdigstilt anlegg tilpasset bruk i skolehverdag og nærmiljø. Totalentreprisen skal omfatte alle ytelser som er nødvendige for å levere et komplett anlegg, herunder prosjektering, grunnarbeider, fundamentering, drenering, levering og montering av multibane, sportsdekke, oppmerking, ballfangere, porter, integrert spilleutstyr og universelt utformet adkomst. I tillegg skal entreprenøren gjennomføre nødvendig kontroll og kvalitetssikring samt levere dokumentasjon, opplæring og grunnlag for drift og vedlikehold ved overlevering. Detaljerte tekniske krav, funksjonskrav, dokumentasjonskrav og opsjoner fremgår av kravspesifikasjonen og øvrige vedlegg til konkurransegrunnlaget. Ballbingen skal leveres, monteres og dokumenteres i samsvar med gjeldende sikkerhetskrav for fritt tilgjengelig idrettsutstyr, jf. NS-EN 15312. Senest ved overtakelse skal totalentreprenøren overlevere samsvarserklæring eller sertifikat, samt enkel og oversiktlig FDV-dokumentasjon på norsk for forvaltning, drift og vedlikehold. Ansatte hos totalentreprenøren og eventuelle underleverandører som direkte medvirker til å oppfylle kontrakten, skal ha lønns- og arbeidsvilkår i samsvar med forskrift om lønns- og arbeidsvilkår i offentlige kontrakter. Totalentreprenøren skal på forespørsel dokumentere at kravene er oppfylt. Totalentreprenøren skal ivareta rollen som koordinator for sikkerhet, helse og arbeidsmiljø (SHA) i utførelsesfasen på byggeplassen. Anleggsområdet skal holdes forsvarlig sikret mot uvedkommende, særlig barn og unge, i hele byggeperioden. Ved ferdigstillelse skal området ryddes, og tilstøtende terreng skal settes i tilfredsstillende stand. Kontraktsgrunnlag – forenklinger og særlige bestemmelser til NS 8407 Kontrakten skal baseres på NS 8407 Alminnelige kontraktsbestemmelser for totalentrepriser, med følgende avvik, forenklinger og særlige bestemmelser som skal fremgå av eget kontraktsvedlegg: Sikkerhetsstillelse (NS 8407 pkt. 7): Totalentreprenøren fritas fra plikten til å stille sikkerhet for sine kontraktsforpliktelser i byggetiden og reklamasjonstiden. Prisregulering (NS 8407 pkt. 26.2): Kontraktssummen er en fast pris og skal ikke indeksreguleres. Varsling og kommunikasjon (NS 8407 pkt. 5): All skriftlig varsling og kommunikasjon mellom partene, herunder varsel om endringer og krav om fristforlengelse, kan skje per e-post til partenes oppnevnte representanter. Fakturering og betalingsplan (NS 8407 pkt. 27): Det skal faktureres etter følgende milepælsplan i stedet for månedlige avdragsnotaer: 40 % ved ferdigstilt grunnarbeid og levering av ballbingemateriell til byggeplass 50 % ved signert overtakelsesprotokoll 10 % ved overlevert godkjent FDV-dokumentasjon og samsvarserklæring Betalingsfrist er 30 dager etter mottatt korrekt elektronisk faktura (EHF).

title: Kvalifikasjonsfase - Evaluering av veiledende innholdslister
description: Utdanningsdirektoratet har etter oppdrag fra Kunnskapsdepartementet (oppdrag nr. 2025-20) utviklet veiledende innholdslister til noen fag i grunnskolen. Kunnskapsdepartementet begrunner innholdslistene med at selv om mange er tilfredse med det store handlingsrommet i LK20, så er det skoler som er usikre på om de bruker det på en god måte. Det kan også være krevende å arbeide med skolens verdigrunnlag i de ulike fagene. Innholdslistene bør ses i sammenheng med flere rapporter i EVAFF-evalueringen, som har funnet variasjon i hvordan LK20 blir tatt i bruk. Les mer om EVAFF her: Evaluering av fagfornyelsen | udir.no.Veiledende innholdslister er en ny form for støtte til lærerne og skolenes arbeid med læreplanene og til valg av innhold i opplæringen. De skal støtte skolenes arbeid med verdigrunnlaget, og bidra med felles referanserammer og økt innsikt iblant annet felles historie, kulturarv og tradisjoner. Listene skal også bidra til kunnskap om samisk og nasjonale minoriteters kultur og samfunnsliv. Listene har en bred tilnærming til innholdet i hele læreplanverket, og skal både bygge på, og støtte opp under, verdigrunnlaget i overordnet del av læreplanverket.Listene viser forslag til konkret innhold som lærerne kan bruke når de planlegger og gjennomfører undervisning i fagene, og kan være et utgangspunkt for samtaler om hva som er faglig relevant innhold i opplæringen. Samtidig er listene ikke uttømmende for alt som kan være relevant innhold i opplæringen, og innholdet på listene er knyttet til verdigrunnlaget og felles referanserammer.Innholdslistene i musikk og samfunnsfag ble ferdigstilt i juni 2026. Samfunnsfag har en felles liste for LK20 og LK20S. Innholdslisten i musikk samisk kommer i løpet av høsten 2026. Til skoleåret 2027/2028 vil innholdslistene i norsk, i norsk for elever med samisk som førstespråk, samisk som førstespråk og samisk som andrespråk være klare. Utviklingen av lister i mat og helse, KRLE, kunst og håndverk og duodji er utsatt på ubestemt tid.

title: Finland – Construction work – Osallistumispyyntö: Kulttuurikeskus Stoan perusparannus ja laajennus, projektinjohtourakoitsijan hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on projektinjohtourakoitsijan hankinta kulttuurikeskus Stoan perusparannuksen ja laajennuksen hankkeeseen. Urakka käsittää projektinjohtotehtävät sekä rakennus- ja talotekniset työt. Hanke toteutetaan kehitysvaiheellisena yhteistoiminnallisena projektinjohtourakkana, jossa kehitysvaiheen työ toteutetaan projektinjohtourakkasopimuksen kehitysvaiheen sopimuksella ennen varsinaisen projektinjohtourakkasopimuksen allekirjoittamista. Stoan hankkeen laajuudeksi on tarveselvityksessä arvioitu noin 18 750 brm², josta peruskorjauksen ja muutoksen osuus on noin 11 310 brm² ja laajennuksen osuus noin 7 440 brm². Tilaohjelmassa on arvioitu palvelujen tilantarpeeksi yhteensä noin 10 700 hym2. Tällä hetkellä on käynnissä kaksivaiheinen arkkitehtuurikilpailu, minkä ensimmäisessä vaiheessa tammi–toukokuu 2026) osallistujat esittävät kaupunkikuvallisen ratkaisun, laativat tilakonseptin ja kilpailuohjelman mukaiset muut tilalliset, toiminnalliset ja taloudelliset kriteerit täyttävän arkkitehtonisesti korkeatasoisen ideasuunnitelman perusparannetusta ja laajennetusta Stoan kulttuurikeskuksesta. Arkkitehtuurikilpailun 2. vaiheessa (syys–joulukuu 2026) jatkoon valitut osallistujat esittävät tarkennetun suunnitelman. Tavoitteena on, että päätös arkkitehtuurikilpailun tuloksesta tehdään 5/2027 mennessä. PJ-urakoitsija on tavoitteena valita toukokuussa 2027. Hankesuunnittelu ajoittuu helmikuusta syyskuuhun 2027, kehitysvaihe kesäkuusta 2027 marraskuuhun 2028 ja yleis- ja toteutussuunnittelu lokakuusta 2027 lokakuuhun 2028. Rakentamisen on tavoitteena käynnistyä tammikuussa 2029. Koko hankkeen rakennusajan arvioidaan olevan noin 32 kuukautta, ja tavoitteena on saada kokonaisuus valmiiksi elokuuhun 2031 mennessä. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö sekä vertailuperusteet on kuvattu hankintailmoituksen liitteenä olevissa alustavissa tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Liiteasiakirjat löytyvät julkaisun Tarjouspalvelu-sivuilta kohdassa "Liitteet ja linkit" ilmoitetusta linkistä.

title: Denmark – Construction work – Renovering af afdeling 11 Kapellanvej 25-35 og 34-36 og afdeling 13 Taarnvang 1 - 19 og 6 – 22, Holbæk
description: Renoveringen af Afdeling 11 Kapellanvej 25-35 og 34-36 & Afdeling 13 Taarnvang 1 - 19 og 6 – 22 i Holbæk udføres parallelt. Udbuddet gennemføres som udbud med forhandling efter udbudslovens afsnit II, jf. §§ 61-66. Årsagen til at udbuddet gennemføres som udbud med forhandling er, at Byggeforeningen af 1933 (herefter Byg33) ønsker en drøftelse af, hvilke projektmæssige og aftalemæssige forhold, der har væsentlig betydning for tilbuddet. Da er tale om et samlet udbud af en totalrådgiveraftale og en hovedentrepriseaftale, bundet sammen af en fælles samarbejdsaftale. Ansøgeren skal bestå af et team. På samme måde afgiver de prækvalificerede teams ét samlet tilbud på opgaven. Projektet udbydes samlet, da det er BYG33’s vurdering, at realiseringen af opgaven sker mest hensigtsmæssigt i en samlet aftale med henblik på at minimere omkostninger til grænseflader og forenkle koordinerings- og ansvarsforhold. Udbuddet omfatter to faser: en ansøgningsfase og en tilbudsfase herunder eventuelt en eller flere forhandlingsrunder. Udbudsbetingelserne indeholder de formelle betingelser for gennemførelse af udbudsprocessen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at ansøgere, og senere de udvalgte tilbudsgivere, sætter sig grundigt ind i dette dokument.

Ces aménagements viendront compléter les travaux réalisés dans le cadre du projet de construction de l’Hôpital Loire Santé, dans le strict respect de l’intégrité des éléments déjà réceptionnés. En complément, une réflexion sur le traitement des ambiances intérieures sera menée en cohérence avec le projet architectural, notamment en matière de polychromie, ainsi qu’avec l’identité et l’image de marque du CHU. Cette démarche vise à concevoir des espaces médico-soignants accueillants, chaleureux et ressourçants, favorisant le bien-être des utilisateurs et adaptés aux exigences d’un usage collectif. Le présent marché se décompose ainsi en deux (2) éléments de mission, qui sont les suivants : - Elément de mission n°1 : Déploiement des intentions d’aménagement intérieur par type d’espace: « Etudes de Conception » - Elément de mission n°2 : Description des préconisations d’aménagement en adéquation avec les intentions définies dans l’élément de mission n°1, nécessaires pour l’acquisition des mobiliers et éléments de mobiliers décoratifs

description: Le projet aRTwin, cofinancé par l'Union européenne (FEDER, programme Région Normandie), vise à construire une plateforme de jumeaux numériques hybrides, associant modèles biophysiques et radiobiologiques et intelligence artificielle multimodale, pour la radiothérapie et l'hadronthérapie (protons et ions carbone ; ions hélium à titre facultatif). Le traitement des données de santé est réalisé exclusivement dans les locaux du Centre. Les prestations s'achèvent au plus tard le 30 novembre 2028, date prolongeable de douze mois au plus. title: Denmark – Construction work – Renovering af afdeling 11 Kapellanvej 25-35 og 34-36 og afdeling 13 Taarnvang 1 - 19 og 6 – 22, Holbæk
description: Renoveringen af Afdeling 11 Kapellanvej 25-35 og 34-36 & Afdeling 13 Taarnvang 1 - 19 og 6 – 22 i Holbæk udføres parallelt. Udbuddet gennemføres som udbud med forhandling efter udbudslovens afsnit II, jf. §§ 61-66. Årsagen til at udbuddet gennemføres som udbud med forhandling er, at Byggeforeningen af 1933 (herefter Byg33) ønsker en drøftelse af, hvilke projektmæssige og aftalemæssige forhold, der har væsentlig betydning for tilbuddet. Da er tale om et samlet udbud af en totalrådgiveraftale og en hovedentrepriseaftale, bundet sammen af en fælles samarbejdsaftale. Ansøgeren skal bestå af et team. På samme måde afgiver de prækvalificerede teams ét samlet tilbud på opgaven. Projektet udbydes samlet, da det er BYG33’s vurdering, at realiseringen af opgaven sker mest hensigtsmæssigt i en samlet aftale med henblik på at minimere omkostninger til grænseflader og forenkle koordinerings- og ansvarsforhold. Udbuddet omfatter to faser: en ansøgningsfase og en tilbudsfase herunder eventuelt en eller flere forhandlingsrunder. Udbudsbetingelserne indeholder de formelle betingelser for gennemførelse af udbudsprocessen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at ansøgere, og senere de udvalgte tilbudsgivere, sætter sig grundigt ind i dette dokument.

title: Norway – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Qualification phase - Evaluation of guiding content lists.
description: The Norwegian Directorate of Education and Training has, on behalf of the Ministry of Education and Research (assignment no. 2025-20) developed guiding content lists for some subjects in primary and secondary schools. The Ministry of Education and Research justifies the list of content that although many are satisfied with the large scope of action in LK20, schools are unsure if they use it in a good way. Work on the school ́s value basis in the different disciplines can also be challenging. The list of contents ought to be seen in the context of several reports in the EVAFF evaluation, which has found variation in how LK20 is adopted. Read more about EVAFF here: Evaluation of the renewal of subjects | udir.no.Guiding content lists is a new form of support for teachers and schools ́ work with the curriculums and for choosing content in the training. They shall support the schools' work with the values basis and contribute with joint frameworks of reference and increased insight in, among other things, common history, cultural heritage and traditions. The lists shall also contribute to knowledge on Sami and national minority culture and social life. The lists have a broad approach to the content of the entire curriculum and shall be built on, and support, the value basis in the general part of the curriculum. The lists show proposals for concrete content that teachers can use when planning and executing education in the subjects, and can be a starting point for discussions on what is the subject relevant content in the training. At the same time, the lists are not exhaustive for all that can be relevant content in the training, and the content of the lists is connected to the values and joint reference frames. The list of content in music and social studies was completed in June 2026. Social studies has a joint list for LK20 and LK20S. The list of contents of music in Sami comes during autumn 2026. For the school year 2027/2028, the content lists in Norwegian, in Norwegian for students with Sami as the first language, Sami as the first language and Sami as the second language will be ready. The development of lists in food and health, KRLE, art and crafts and duodji are postponed indefinitely.

Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens ist die Vergabe der nachfolgenden drei Leistungsbereiche: 1. Wartungsleistungen Regelmäßige, planmäßige und fachgerechte Durchführung der im Leistungsverzeichnis beschriebenen Wartungsleistungen an den vorhandenen haustechnischen Anlagen. Hierzu gehören insbesondere die erforderlichen Prüfungen, Funktionskontrollen und Wartungsmaßnahmen einschließlich der Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten. 2. Reparatur- und Instandsetzungsleistungen Bedarfsabhängige Durchführung von Reparatur- und Instandsetzungsleistungen zur Behebung festgestellter Mängel und Störungen sowie zur Wiederherstellung der ordnungsgemäßen Funktionsfähigkeit der technischen Anlagen. Die Beauftragung erfolgt grundsätzlich nach gesonderter Freigabe durch den Auftraggeber. Die Abrechnung erfolgt auf Grundlage der im Leistungsverzeichnis angebotenen Einheitspreise beziehungsweise Stundenverrechnungssätze. 3. Notdienstbereitschaft und Notdiensteinsätze Vorhaltung und Organisation eines Notdienstes zur Entgegennahme und Bearbeitung dringender technischer Störungen außerhalb der regulären Betriebszeiten. Die Notdienstbereitschaft ist insbesondere werktags von 16:00 Uhr bis 07:00 Uhr, an Wochenenden von Freitag 16:00 Uhr bis Montag 07:00 Uhr sowie an Feiertagen ganztägig sicherzustellen. Bei einem als Notfall eingestuften Ereignis muss qualifiziertes Fachpersonal spätestens innerhalb von 60 Minuten nach Eingang der Störungsmeldung am betroffenen Leistungsort eintreffen. Die Vorhaltung der Notdienstbereitschaft wird über eine gesonderte Bereitschaftspauschale vergütet. Tatsächliche Notdiensteinsätze werden nach den vereinbarten Stundenverrechnungssätzen und Zuschlägen abgerechnet. Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen umfassen darüber hinaus die Abstimmung und Koordination mit dem Auftraggeber, eine transparente Wartungsplanung, die Nachverfolgung von Störungsmeldungen sowie die nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sämtlicher durchgeführter Leistungen. Die Vergabe erfolgt als Gesamtauftrag an einen Auftragnehmer. Es ist vorgesehen, eine Rahmenvereinbarung mit einer Grundlaufzeit von 24 Monaten abzuschließen. Dem Auftraggeber wird das einseitige Recht eingeräumt, die Rahmenvereinbarung einmalig um weitere 24 Monate zu verlängern. Die maximale Vertragslaufzeit beträgt somit 48 Monate. Die konkreten Leistungsanforderungen, Anlagen, Wartungsintervalle, Mengenansätze, Ausführungsbedingungen, Preispositionen und Abrechnungsmodalitäten ergeben sich aus dem Leistungsverzeichnis (Anlage 02) einschließlich der zugehörigen Vorbemerkungen sowie den weiteren Verfahrens- und Vertragsunterlagen. Die im Leistungsverzeichnis angegebenen kalkulatorischen Mengen und Wertungsansätze dienen der einheitlichen Angebotskalkulation und Preiswertung. Sie begründen keinen Anspruch des Auftragnehmers auf Abruf bestimmter Mengen, soweit keine verbindlichen Mindestabnahmemengen ausdrücklich vereinbart sind.

title: Dodávky křemičitého písku pro trakční účely v období 2026-2029
description: Předmětem této Zakázky jsou dodávky sušeného křemičitého písku pro trakční účely dle podmínek Zadavatele stanovených ve Výzvě, návrhu Rámcové kupní smlouvy a v přílohách těchto dokumentů. Jednotlivé dodávky Zboží budou zadávány dle aktuální potřeby Zadavatele na základě samostatných objednávek. Práva a povinnosti Zadavatele a účastníka upravené v této Výzvě se přiměřeně řídí zákonem č. 89/2012 Sb., občanský zákoník, v platném znění, zejména pak ustanoveními § 1772 – 1779 upravujícími veřejnou soutěž o nejvhodnější nabídku. Pro vyloučení pochybností se výslovně uvádí, že uvedená Zakázka a práva a povinnosti s ní související nepodléhají režimu zákona číslo 134/2016 Sb., o zadávání veřejných zakázek, v platném znění. Zakázka je financována z vlastních zdrojů Zadavatele.

description: Der Auftragnehmer (AN) übernimmt gemäß § 10 Abs. 2 Satz 1 BetrSichV und §§ 5 ff. der DGUV V3 unter Beachtung der gesetzlichen Vorschriften in den Liegenschaften des Auftraggebers die Prüfung der ca. 14.300 ortsveränderlichen und ca. 3.300 ortsfesten elektrischen Betriebsmittel. title: Ireland – Financial information systems – Request for Tenders for the Provision of Financial Transactions Transfer Pricing Tools
description: This Public Procurement Competition will be divided into two (2) Lots (each a “Lot”) as described below. Each Lot will result in a separate contract. Lot 1: A Loan Pricing, Research and Analysis Platform. The Contracting Authority requires access to a platform or database which provides comprehensive information on loan transactions that can be used for tax administration purposes; primarily transfer pricing. Lot 2: A Financial Markets Data, Credit Rating Analysis and Debt Capacity Analysis Research Platform. The Contracting Authority requires the provision of a platform(s) which allow(s) access to financial markets data and provides the capability to carry out credit risk scoring and debt capacity analysis primarily for tax compliance purposes including transfer pricing. There are separate Tender Response Documents and Pricing Schedules available for Lots 1 and 2. Tenderers must submit the Tender Response Document and Pricing Schedule which is relevant to the Lot they are tendering for.

description: North Lanarkshire Council (the “Council”) is undertaking a major digital transformation programme to deliver gigabit capable broadband connectivity to approximately 37,000 Council owned social housing properties across the authority area. title: Beschaffung und Ausstattung eines Fahrzeugs zum Einsatz als Mobiler Tele-Arbeitsplatz (MoTA)
description: Die Uniklinik RWTH Aachen hat im Förderaufruf "Demonstration und Erprobung innovativer Lösungen für die zivile Sicherheit" vom Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt Fördergelder für den Ausbau eines Fahrzeuges erhalten. Das Fahrzeug, auch "Mobiler Tele-Arbeitsplatz" ist ein Kastenfahrzeug oder Kofferaufbau, der ähnlich einem Einsatzleitwagen 1,5 mit zwei Arbeitsplätzen und einem Besprechungsbereich ausgestattet sein soll. Das Fahrzeug soll neben der technischen Ausstattung für Telemedizin, Telepflege und Tele-experten-gestützte Anwendungen mit Demonstratoren vorangegangener Forschungsprojekte ausgestattet werden. Damit soll es in zukünftigen Studien zum Einsatz kommen und eine Infrastruktur für technische Anwendungen, bspw. Telemedizin bieten. Die Ausschreibung umfasst die Beschaffung des Fahrgestells inkl. Ausbau als Kastenwagen oder Kofferaufbau mit einem Antennenmast und einer dachmontierten Drohne.

Das Fahrzeug, auch "Mobiler Tele-Arbeitsplatz" ist ein Kastenfahrzeug oder Kofferaufbau, der ähnlich einem Einsatzleitwagen 1,5 mit zwei Arbeitsplätzen und einem Besprechungsbereich ausgestattet sein soll. Das Fahrzeug soll neben der technischen Ausstattung für Telemedizin, Telepflege und Tele-experten-gestützte Anwendungen mit Demonstratoren vorangegangener Forschungsprojekte ausgestattet werden. Damit soll es in zukünftigen Studien zum Einsatz kommen und eine Infrastruktur für technische Anwendungen, bspw. Telemedizin bieten. Die Ausschreibung umfasst die Beschaffung des Fahrgestells inkl. Ausbau als Kastenwagen oder Kofferaufbau mit einem Antennenmast und einer dachmontierten Drohne.

title: Kjøp av konsulenttjenester - Produktområdeleder for produktområde landdyr
description: Formålet med anskaffelsen er å styrke Mattilsynets arbeid innen produktutvikling gjennom innleie av en erfaren konsulent som skal ivareta rollen som produktområdeleder og samtidig ha ansvar som produktleder for ett av områdets produktteam – Produktteam legemidler. Produktområde Landdyr består i dag av fire produktteam med ulike ansvarsområder. Teamene arbeider i stor grad selvstendig, men har samtidig avhengigheter og behov for samordning knyttet til retning, prioriteringer og måloppnåelse. Produktområdet er nyetablert og som produktområdeleder vil konsulentens hovedoppgave være å samarbeide med produktteamene om å finne en hensiktsmessig organisering av området fremover. Samtidig blir det viktig å utvikle og forvalte områdestrategien for Landdyr sammen med teamene, legge til rette for tydelige prioriteringer på tvers av teamene, håndtere avhengigheter og sikre god koordinering mot sponsorgruppe og øvrige interessenter. I tillegg må områdeleder følge opp at området samlet skaper ønskede resultater og effekter i tråd med Mattilsynets strategier og ambisjoner.

title: Kjøp av konsulenttjenester - Produktområdeleder for produktområde landdyr
description: Formålet med anskaffelsen er å styrke Mattilsynets arbeid innen produktutvikling gjennom bruk av erfaren konsulent som gjennom rollen som produktområdeleder skal støtte etableringen og videreutviklingen av Produktområde landdyr. Produktområde Landdyr består i dag av fire produktteam med ulike ansvarsområder hvor det er avhengigheter mellom teamene og funksjoner i øvrige deler av virksomheten. Ansvarsområdet er bredt og omfatter alt fra digitale tilsynsløsninger for landdyr, kjøttkontrollsystem på slakterier, personellgodkjenning, bruk av veterinære legemidler, samt sentrale registre. Teamene har over tid opparbeidet betydelig domenekunnskap og arbeidet selvstendig med sine oppdrag, men det er behov for å fremstå enhetlig, og sammen sikre effektene på tvers som bidrar til økt mattrygghet, dyrehelse og dyrevelferd. Konsulentens hovedoppgave vil være å koordinere og understøtte dette samarbeidet, og sammen med produktlederne bidra til å etablere tydelige rammer for organisering, styring og samhandling på produktområdet. Arbeidet skal bygge videre på teamenes eksisterende kompetanse, erfaringer og eierskap til domenet. Oppdraget innebærer å støtte utviklingen av en felles områdestrategi med tydelige mål og prioriteringer i tråd med virksomhetens strategiske ambisjoner. Konsulenten skal bidra til å etablere gode arbeidsformer for helhetlige beslutninger, håndtering av avhengigheter og oppfølging av områdets resultater og effekter i samarbeid med produktlederne, ledergruppen i Avdeling utvikling, og andre relevante interessenter. Et sentralt mål med oppdraget er å styrke produktområdets evne til å utvikle felles retning og samarbeide på tvers over tid. Konsulenten skal derfor legge vekt på involvering, kompetanseoverføring og eierskap hos eksisterende produktledere, slik at Mattilsynet selv kan videreføre produktområdeledelsen etter oppdragets avslutning.

title: Netherlands – Special-purpose road passenger-transport services – Leerlingenvervoer en Jeugdhulpvervoer voor de Rijnstreekgemeenten Alphen aan den Rijn , Kaag en Braassem en Nieuwkoop
description: Wegens het verlopen van de huidige Overeenkomst per augustus 2027 wordt het Leerlingenvervoer door de drie deelnemende gemeenten opnieuw aanbesteed. Voor de gemeenten Alphen aan den Rijn en Kaag en Braassem eindigen de Overeenkomsten voor de huidige aparte inkoop Jeugdhulpvervoer respectievelijk 31 juli 2027 en 31 december 2027. De gemeente Alphen aan den Rijn wenst per augustus 2027 het Jeugdhulpvervoer mee te nemen in de nieuwe Overeenkomst. De gemeente Kaag en Braassem wenst haar Jeugdhulpvervoer in de nieuwe Overeenkomst mee te nemen met ingang van 1 januari 2028. De gemeente Nieuwkoop heeft vooralsnog besloten haar Jeugdhulpvervoer zelfstandig te organiseren maar behoudt wel de optie om op ieder willekeurig moment gedurende de looptijd van deze Overeenkomst ook voor het Jeugdhulpvervoer toe te treden. 369 leerlingen 56 jeugdigen

description: skeyes a l’intention de conclure un ou plusieurs contrats avec un ou plusieurs adjudicataires pour l’installation, la location, la maintenance et le support de connexions réseau Layer 2 entre les data centres de skeyes à Steenokkerzeel et plusieurs sites distants du système nationwide WAM de skeyes, dans une architecture en étoile (hub-spoke), afin de soutenir les phases 2A, 2B et 3 du projet WAM national (nationwide). Le marché est divisé en lots, chaque site distant pour lequel une connexion réseau doit être réalisée constituant un lot distinct. Les contrats seront conclus pour une durée initiale de 5 ans, à compter de la réception de la connexion réseau réalisée. skeyes peut résilier tout contrat chaque année, moyennant le respect d’un préavis de 3 mois. En outre, skeyes peut renouveler tacitement chaque contrat 3 fois sous les mêmes conditions, chaque fois pour une période supplémentaire de 1 an. Par conséquent, la durée indicative maximale de chaque contrat est de 8 ans.

description: Logius verwerkt berichten op werkdagen als intermediair voor de Belastingdienst . De berichten (G-Rekening), worden via Swift verwerkt en daarvoor zijn garanties ingebouwd om fraude te voorkomen. Logius dient in het kader van de Digipoort dienstverlening gebruik te maken van het netwerk van SWIFT voor berichtenverkeer tussen Nederlandse banken en de Afnemer. De Afnemer is aangesloten op de SWIFT Alliance Cloud (SAC). Belangrijkste componenten van de SWIFT dienstverlening zijn: o Het beheer van een connectie van het SWIFT-netwerk op een overheidsdatacenter door middel van de SAC; o De verwerking van door Nederlandse banken aangeleverde berichten met informatie over g-rekeningen binnen het overheidsdatacenter; o De aanlevering van deze berichten aan de Digipoort voor de verdere aflevering naar de Afnemer. De huidigen overeenkomst loopt af en Logius heeft behoefte SWIFT dienstverlening die geleverd dient te worden op de SWIFT Alliance Cloud. Zie selectiedocument

title: SOLE SOURCE: NORTEK USA Aquadopp Current Sensors for the NWS National Data Buoy Center
description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration�s (NOAA) Acquisition and Grants Office, Eastern Acquisition Division-Kansas City intends to negotiate and award a purchase order, on a sole source basis, under authority of RFO FAR 6.103-1, with small business entity Nortek USA, Inc. for two (2) Aquadopp Current Meters for the NWS National Data Buoy Center at Stennis Space Center, MS. Sole Source Justification: Compatibility to existing systems or equipment - The required supplies or service must be compatible in all aspects (form, fit, and function) with existing systems or equipment, and the source is uniquely qualified to meet the requirement. Since the inception of the US Coast Guard sponsoring current measurement on two buoy stations off the coast of Washington state the NDBC has supported this effort with serial communication subsurface current sensors. As multiple sensors became obsolete obsolete the US Coast Guard program did not have sufficient funds to identify a replacement but the TAO program began a refresh effort that tested new current sensor technologies to address that current meter need. After two years of side-by-side sensor testing, the Nortek Aquadopp current sensors were selected as the operational unit for the TAO network and thus also the US Coast Guard requiremnt. To complete the TAO refresh effort the mechanical, electrical, and digital processing for the Nortek current sensors were implemented across the TAO array and on the US Coast Guard sponsored buoys. This procurement is for two current sensors to replace units recovered in fiscal year 2026 that were damaged beyond repair. The replacements must fit in the mechanical mounts, have the same electrical cabling connection, and have the same command and message formats as the Nortek Aquadopp current sensors. As such to meet the compatibility requirements of the existing US Coast Guard sponsored buoys the Nortek Aquadopp current sensors must be purchased as drop-in replacements. This pre-solicitation notice is not a request for competitive proposals and no solicitation package is available. However, firms that believe they can fully meet the government�s requirements may submit substantiating documentation or a request for additional information in writing to the (Contract Specialist) within 15 days after publication of this presolicitation notice. Such requests and documentation will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether or not to conduct this procurement on a competitive basis. A determination by the government not to conduct a competitive procurement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the government. Oral communications are not acceptable in response to this pre-solicitation notice.

title: Germany – Structural shell work – Neubau Marion-Dönhoff-Schule (MDS) mit Stadtteilhaus
description: Der Bauherr beabsichtigt den Neubau der Marion-Dönhoff-Schule mit Stadtteilhaus an der Möwenstraße 40 in 26388 Wilhelmshaven zu errichten. Es sind drei rechteckige Gebäude in konventioneller Betonbauweise, Stahlbetondecken (außer Sporthallendach, dort Trapezblech auf Holzbindern) und genutzten Flachdächern geplant, die mit Verbindungsgängen verbunden sind. Haus 1: Abmessung B/L ca. 31,5/ 45 m, 3-geschossig Haus 2: Abmessung B/L ca. 31,5/ 50 m, 3-geschossig Haus 3: Abmessung B/L ca. 45,5/ 69 m, 1- u. 2-geschossig Zunächst erfolgt ausschließlich die Ausführung der Rohbauarbeiten. Ca. ab Juli 2027 bis November 2028 werden Rohbau- und Ausbauarbeiten parallel durchgeführt. Das Baustellenumfeld ist durch Wohnbebauung, Bildungs- und Kinderbetreuungseinrichtungen, Sportanlagen und weitere öffentliche Nutzungen geprägt. Hieraus ergeben sich erhöhte Anforderungen an die Organisation des Baustellenverkehrs sowie an die Sicherung gegenüber unbeteiligten Dritten. Baustellen-, Liefer-, Fahrrad-, Fußgänger- und Individualverkehr überlagern sich im unmittelbaren Umfeld der Baumaßnahme. Die Zufahrt zur Baustelle erfolgt über die im Baustelleneinrichtungsplan ausgewiesenen Zufahrten und das bestehende öffentliche Straßennetz. Im Bereich der Möwenstraße bestehen verkehrliche Beschränkungen für Fahrzeuge über 7,5 t. Für den Baustellenverkehr liegt eine entsprechende Ausnahmegenehmigung des Bauherrn vor.

title: 26-58007 Mobile Ground Control Station (MGCS) and Cargo Trailer for Drone Field Operations
description: 26-58007 Mobile Ground Control Station (MGCS) and Cargo Trailer for Drone Field Operations The National Research Council of Canada (NRC) Centre for Drone Innovation (CDI), part of the Drone and Flight Autonomy Laboratory (DFAL), requires the design, integration, and delivery of a Mobile Ground Control Station (MGCS) and complementary enclosed cargo trailer (collectively referred to as the “MGCS System”). The MGCS System will support experimental flight data acquisition and processing in remote environments, and in-situ demonstrations of novel applications of unmanned aerial systems (UAS), counter-UAS technologies, and mobile sensor networks. It will support research activities in: • Concurrent multi-UAV operations, including ground robots; • Exploration and Mapping, and Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) applications; • Electronic Warfare (EW), Security, Counter-measures deployment, and drone threat mitigation; • BVLOS experimentation; and • AI/autonomy research. Background Researchers at the NRC-CDI regularly conduct outdoor experiments and advanced technology demonstrations at remote test locations for government and industrial clients. These activities require transporting multiple drones, instrumentation, computing systems, field equipment, and crew. Current deployments require multiple transport vehicles and significant setup time. The MGCS System is intended to consolidate these capabilities with efficient reliable operations into a mobile platform. 1.0 Requirement: The MGCS System must operate as an extension of NRC’s laboratory computing, and communications infrastructure and enable rapid deployment to remote field locations, with flight testing and data collection activities commencing within approximately 30 minutes of arrival. Given the fast development pace of UAS and C-UAS technologies, the MGCS System must be modular in its design approach and implementation to support future expansion, subsystems replacements, and integration of future sensors, communications equipment, computing infrastructure upgrades, and mission systems. The requirements identified in the following subsections represent NRC's fundamental requirements for the MGCS System and are intended to describe the minimum functionality, features, and performance objectives sought under this SOR. The requirements are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all components, features, or accessories that may be required to provide a complete and operational solution. Where appropriate, Offerors may propose equivalent or alternative solutions, products, features, components, or configurations, provided that the proposed recommendation meets or exceeds the functional, operational, and performance requirements specified in this Statement of Requirement. Offerors should clearly identify any proposed substitutions and provide sufficient technical information and rationale to demonstrate equivalency. Offerors may also identify optional features, enhancements, or add-ons that are not included in the proposed compliant solution. Any such optional items must be clearly identified and priced separately in the Annex Basis of Payment and will not form part of the evaluation unless expressly stated otherwise in the solicitation. Following contract award, NRC's Technical Authority will work collaboratively with the successful Offeror during the design phase in a stage-gate review process to refine and finalize the requirements, system layouts, integration details, equipment list, and implementation plan to ensure the MGCS System is optimized for NRC's current and future evolving operational needs. Any resulting refinements must remain within the scope of the Contract and shall not reduce the minimum technical requirements specified herein. Please refer to tender documents for the Specifications.

It will support research activities in: • Concurrent multi-UAV operations, including ground robots; • Exploration and Mapping, and Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) applications; • Electronic Warfare (EW), Security, Counter-measures deployment, and drone threat mitigation; • BVLOS experimentation; and • AI/autonomy research. Background Researchers at the NRC-CDI regularly conduct outdoor experiments and advanced technology demonstrations at remote test locations for government and industrial clients. These activities require transporting multiple drones, instrumentation, computing systems, field equipment, and crew. Current deployments require multiple transport vehicles and significant setup time. The MGCS System is intended to consolidate these capabilities with efficient reliable operations into a mobile platform. 1.0 Requirement: The MGCS System must operate as an extension of NRC’s laboratory computing, and communications infrastructure and enable rapid deployment to remote field locations, with flight testing and data collection activities commencing within approximately 30 minutes of arrival. Given the fast development pace of UAS and C-UAS technologies, the MGCS System must be modular in its design approach and implementation to support future expansion, subsystems replacements, and integration of future sensors, communications equipment, computing infrastructure upgrades, and mission systems. The requirements identified in the following subsections represent NRC's fundamental requirements for the MGCS System and are intended to describe the minimum functionality, features, and performance objectives sought under this SOR. The requirements are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all components, features, or accessories that may be required to provide a complete and operational solution. Where appropriate, Offerors may propose equivalent or alternative solutions, products, features, components, or configurations, provided that the proposed recommendation meets or exceeds the functional, operational, and performance requirements specified in this Statement of Requirement. Offerors should clearly identify any proposed substitutions and provide sufficient technical information and rationale to demonstrate equivalency. Offerors may also identify optional features, enhancements, or add-ons that are not included in the proposed compliant solution. Any such optional items must be clearly identified and priced separately in the Annex Basis of Payment and will not form part of the evaluation unless expressly stated otherwise in the solicitation. Following contract award, NRC's Technical Authority will work collaboratively with the successful Offeror during the design phase in a stage-gate review process to refine and finalize the requirements, system layouts, integration details, equipment list, and implementation plan to ensure the MGCS System is optimized for NRC's current and future evolving operational needs. Any resulting refinements must remain within the scope of the Contract and shall not reduce the minimum technical requirements specified herein. title: 26-58170 Mobile Command Centre (MCC) for the Centre for Autonomous Flight Systems (CAFS)
description: 26-58170 Mobile Command Centre (MCC) for the Centre for Autonomous Flight Systems (CAFS), Drone and Flight Autonomy Laboratory The National Research Council of Canada’s (NRC) Drone and Flight Autonomy Laboratory (DFAL) requires one (1) purpose-built Mobile Command Centre (MCC) for its Centre for Autonomous Flight Systems (CAFS), located at the Ottawa Airport adjacent to the NRC Flight Research Laboratory. The MCC is a self-contained vehicle that serves as the ground control, telemetry, safety-monitoring and data-recording facility for flight trials. It must support two lines of work: the flight autonomy and human factors research conducted at CAFS, and the Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) operations of DFAL, at field sites across Canada. BACKGROUND: The Centre for Autonomous Flight Systems (CAFS) expands upon the existing capabilities of the NRC Flight Research Laboratory (FRL). It provides an advanced research infrastructure specifically engineered for the development, integration and evaluation of autonomous and optionally piloted aircraft systems. The facility aligns with Canada’s broader defence and aerospace modernization goals, working alongside the Department of National Defence and the Canadian Armed Forces to transition concepts into field-ready deployments. Flight trials of autonomous and remotely piloted aircraft require a ground facility for aircraft control, telemetry and video monitoring and recording, and surveillance of the surrounding airspace. The facility must also support coordination with the research team, air traffic services where available, and other aircraft as required. During flight autonomy and human factors trials, the operators themselves are also subjects of study. Every operator position must therefore be instrumented, and telemetry and video from multiple aircraft, together with operator actions and research logs, must be recorded using a common time base distributed throughout the vehicle network. This work currently relies on the NRC Flight Research Laboratory’s ground-control trailer, which was built for earlier programs. The trailer lacks sufficient seating for the crew required for multi-aircraft trials and has no provision for the masts, mast-head radios, radar and power demands of the current fleet. It also cannot provide the instrumented operator positions and synchronized data recording essential to these trials. The Mobile Command Centre (MCC) will become the primary ground facility, while the existing trailer will continue in a supporting role, towed by the MCC when required for a deployment. Some trials require the crew to be physically separated, with part of the team operating from the trailer and part from the MCC. The two facilities must therefore support a shared network, video feeds and intercom communications when deployed together. The DFAL fleet includes a wide range of aircraft and sensors with diverse ground-control and communications requirements. Ground-control systems range from handheld controllers operating in the standard 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz bands to laptop-based and self-contained ground stations connected to IP radios in the 900 MHz, 2.4 GHz, S-band and C-band ranges. Several systems use directional or phased-array ground antennas that must be elevated on masts, and several aircraft also carry onboard satellite links for over-the-horizon operation. Airspace situational awareness is provided by a ground-based detect-and-avoid radar, which must be mounted at height and present an air picture visible to the entire crew. Multi-aircraft trials require several ground stations to operate simultaneously from the same facility. Operations take place in all seasons, including at remote sites without reliable cellular coverage. The MCC must therefore provide its own power supply, satellite connectivity, heating and cooling. It must also be capable of reaching unpaved sites, including when towing the existing ground-control trailer. The MCC is intended to remain in service for many years, during which the fleet and research program may evolve. To support ongoing maintenance and future modifications, every installed system must be accessible, clearly labelled, documented and replaceable by NRC personnel. The MCC must incorporate specific components that match NRC’s existing equipment to ensure direct interoperability with the NRC Flight Research Laboratory’s ground-control trailer and NRC’s RPAS payloads. This component commonality is required so that the ground segment of the payload data links, the time reference, the recordings and the intercom are shared between the MCC and the trailer when the two facilities are deployed together. Given the custom nature of the build and the integration of NRC’s own equipment, the Offeror must have demonstrated experience in delivering vehicles of this type and in supporting them in service.

Several systems use directional or phased-array ground antennas that must be elevated on masts, and several aircraft also carry onboard satellite links for over-the-horizon operation. Airspace situational awareness is provided by a ground-based detect-and-avoid radar, which must be mounted at height and present an air picture visible to the entire crew. Multi-aircraft trials require several ground stations to operate simultaneously from the same facility. Operations take place in all seasons, including at remote sites without reliable cellular coverage. The MCC must therefore provide its own power supply, satellite connectivity, heating and cooling. It must also be capable of reaching unpaved sites, including when towing the existing ground-control trailer. The MCC is intended to remain in service for many years, during which the fleet and research program may evolve. To support ongoing maintenance and future modifications, every installed system must be accessible, clearly labelled, documented and replaceable by NRC personnel. The MCC must incorporate specific components that match NRC’s existing equipment to ensure direct interoperability with the NRC Flight Research Laboratory’s ground-control trailer and NRC’s RPAS payloads. This component commonality is required so that the ground segment of the payload data links, the time reference, the recordings and the intercom are shared between the MCC and the trailer when the two facilities are deployed together. Given the custom nature of the build and the integration of NRC’s own equipment, the Offeror must have demonstrated experience in delivering vehicles of this type and in supporting them in service.

title: Temperature Cycling Chambers
description: The National Research Council of Canada (NRC) requires the procurement of temperature cycling chambers to support the thermal evaluation of advanced energy storage technologies. As lithium-ion battery systems continue to increase in energy density and are deployed across transportation, aerospace, and stationary energy storage applications, controlled temperature testing is essential to understand how these systems perform under a range of environmental conditions. Temperature cycling chambers provide a controlled thermal environment in which battery cells, modules, and associated components can be exposed to defined temperature conditions during operation. This capability enables the evaluation of battery performance, reliability, and durability while operating across the temperature ranges encountered in real-world applications. The objective of this procurement is to provide the Automotive and Surface Transportation (AST) team with the capability to conduct controlled temperature testing of battery system and system reliability. The AST team operates a unique Canadian facility dedicated to evaluating battery cells and modules well beyond their normal operating envelopes. This procurement will enhance our laboratory infrastructure to meet the rigorous testing demands of the military, aerospace, and light-duty transportation sectors. All deliverables must be received no later than 18 weeks after contract award.

title: Mediator Consultant - Saskatchewan for the Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS)
description: The Programs Branch (PB) of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) has requirements on an "as and when requested" basis for professional resources with expertise and skillsets for the delivery of financial counselling and mediation services. This requirement is to establish a Task Authorization Contract with a qualified Contractor's for services in Saskatchewan. It is intended to result in the award of 5 (five) contracts for 5 (five) years. The Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS) offers free financial counselling and mediation services to farmers who are having difficulties meeting their financial obligations. It is a voluntary, private and confidential service that brings farmers and their creditors together with a Mediator in a neutral forum to reach a mutually acceptable solution. The FDMS Administrator will assign a Financial Consultant and a Mediator to work with the farmer through the mediation process. Confidentiality is extremely important to the quality and effectiveness of the service. Information obtained from the farmer and their creditor(s) is used for the sole purpose of mediation and is shared only among the parties involved in the mediation process. The Mediator will facilitate communication between the farmer and their creditor(s), guide them through the mediation process, and remain neutral throughout. The Mediator will work collaboratively with the Financial Consultant to understand the context of the file, including the recovery plan developed by the farmer and the Financial Consultant. The Mediator will lead the mediation meeting and work with the parties toward a mutually acceptable solution. When the farmer and their creditor(s) reach an agreement, the Mediator will prepare the written arrangement and obtain the signatures of all participants

Problem Statement: Challenge Statement Summary The Government of Canada (GoC) is committed to the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) compliant with its AI Strategy and Guiding Principles, see references noted in this challenge notice. The widespread adoption of AI technologies has created opportunities to enhance decision-making and improve service delivery within the GoC. In fostering the responsible usage of AI, the GoC has established an adoption strategy and guiding principles. To support adherence and implementation, the GoC is interested in testing solutions that provide visibility into AI decision-making processes, enhance the traceability of AI outputs, and ensure that AI models comply with Canadian laws and international standards and best practices. Despite the availability of AI governance solutions from Canadian companies and international providers, existing offerings typically require significant manual effort. This effort is particularly evident in interpreting evolving AI governance requirements, applying them to specific AI systems, updating controls and assessments, and identifying their ecosystem-wide impacts. The challenge seeks innovation to advance capabilities for identifying and incorporating evolving governance requirements, determining their potential impact on registered AI systems, associated controls, assessments, and evidence, and supporting timely reassessment, all while maintaining explainability, traceability, auditability, and human oversight. Details: Essential (mandatory) Outcomes The proposed solution must: 1. Support the continuous alignment of registered AI systems with relevant Canadian regulations, policies, directives, and other governance requirements and be able to identify potentially affected systems and indicate when a reassessment is required. 2. Demonstrate interoperability with enterprise systems, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) platforms and governance solutions and the solution can be integrated with minimal customization. 2A. Demonstrate the ability to exchange governance information with enterprise systems and AI/ML lifecycle tools through standards-based Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), connectors and interoperable data exchange mechanisms. Governance information may include AI system metadata, risk assessments, compliance findings, audit evidence, monitoring results, approvals and decision records. As an example: This governance information includes but is not limited to, information about the AI system, ownership, intent, deployment status, funding state, client information, system objectives, assessments, algorithmic impact assessment, control requirements (playbooks). 2B. Demonstrate how governance information can be collected, aggregated and maintained across multiple systems through APIs, connectors and data exchange mechanisms. 2C. Leverage open standards and documented interfaces to reduce dependency on proprietary technologies enabling interoperability across diverse enterprise environments. 3. Demonstrate how administrative, support and access to governance information and data can be restricted, monitored and controlled in accordance with the GoC requirements. 3A. Enable organizations to define and manage data residency requirements, retention, access and deletion of policies and information without vendor intervention. 4. Enable assessment and reassessment of registered AI systems applicable AI governance requirements, policies, standards, directives while supporting reassessment when governance requirements, assessment frameworks are added modified, replaced or retired. The solution must demonstrate the ability to translate AI governance requirements into traceable controls assess whether applicable controls have been satisfied and identify non-conformities. 4A. Enable authorized users to add, modify, version, replace or retire governance requirements and assessment frameworks to individual AI systems or groups. Demonstrate compliance assessment at minimum against the Policy on Service and Digital, Directive on Automated Decision-Making, Algorithmic Impact Assessment, AI Strategy and AI ethics and responsibilities. 4B. Demonstrate the ability to add, modify, version, replace and retire governance requirements, controls and assessment criteria, and assign them to individual AI systems or groups of AI systems. while supporting the application of different assessment criteria to different AI systems based on their intended use, risk profile or governance requirements Offerors are encouraged to prove extensibility to additional internationally recognized governance frameworks and standards, including the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and the EU Act. 4C. Generate human-readable explanations of assessment and reassessment results. Each finding must identify the applicable requirement, evidence considered, assessment result and confidence score or a certainty measure. user. 4D. Collect, link, and retain assurance artefacts including control mapping, assessment records, evidence references, approvals, exceptions, attestations, remediation actions and audit histories. The Department of National Defense’s Directorate Soldier Systems Program Management (DSSPM) has a requirement for a firm quantity of 4,000 Contoured Ballistic Armor Carrier Systems in accordance with DSSPM Specifications. The requirement includes option quantities and as and when quantities. The requirement is subject to the Buy Canadian Policy. This proposed procurement will be conducted in two phases. Phase 1 consists of an ITQ to establish a list of qualified respondents eligible to participate in the next phase. Phase 2 consists of a Request for Proposal (RFP), which will be issued exclusively to respondents who have successfully qualified through the ITQ. This Notice of Proposed Procurement pertains to Phase 1 only. Canada reserves the right to modify, change, or terminate, at its sole discretion, any or all of the phases of the Proposed Procurement at any time during the Proposed Procurement period. Given that this Proposed Procurement may be cancelled by Canada, it may not result in any of the subsequent procurement processes described in this document.

title: Regenerace sídliště Pivovar
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je provedení stavebních prací spočívajících v komplexní regeneraci veřejných prostranství sídliště Pivovar ve městě Mělník. Součástí stavebních prací je zejména rekonstrukce místních a obslužných komunikací, parkovacích stání, chodníků a pěších cest, včetně souvisejících bouracích, zemních a terénních prací, úprav odvodnění, veřejného osvětlení a související technické infrastruktury. Dále budou provedeny sadové úpravy zahrnující kácení a ošetření stávajících dřevin, nové výsadby stromů, keřů a dalších vegetačních prvků, obnova zelených ploch a revitalizace centrálního parku včetně vybudování hřišť a osazení parkového mobiliáře.

Montenegro – Radiotherapy devices and supplies – Supply of HDR Brachytherapy System within LIFEGATE project
description: Cardiovascular and oncological diseases remain the leading causes of morbidity and mortality in Montenegro and the wider cross-border region. According to GLOBOCAN 2020 data, Montenegro recorded 3,184 new cancer cases and 1,765 cancer-related deaths. With the expected increase in cancer incidence, an ageing population, and existing healthcare challenges, improving early detection, diagnostics, and access to specialised treatment is becoming increasingly important. The Clinical Centre of Montenegro (CCM), as the country's leading tertiary healthcare institution, plays a crucial role in providing specialised oncology services. Through this project, CCM aims to strengthen its diagnostic and treatment capacities, introduce advanced medical technologies, and improve the quality and accessibility of cancer care. A particular focus is placed on early lung cancer detection and the improvement of radiotherapy treatment, including the application of advanced techniques such as stereotactic radiotherapy and brachytherapy. These approaches are expected to contribute to more precise and effective treatment, improved patient outcomes, and better survival rates. Brachytherapy represents an important component of the planned improvements at CCM, offering opportunities to enhance treatment efficiency and quality for patients with various malignancies, particularly cervical, prostate, oesophageal, and lung cancers. The project will also support the development of innovative digital solutions, improved cancer prevention and screening programmes, and the modernisation of healthcare infrastructure through new equipment and professional training. Through cooperation with healthcare institutions in Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Clinical Centre of Montenegro will contribute to strengthening cross-border collaboration, exchanging medical expertise, and promoting common standards in cancer prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. Ultimately, the project aims to improve access to modern oncology services, enhance treatment outcomes, and strengthen the long-term capacities of the Clinical Centre of Montenegro, benefiting patients in Montenegro and the wider cross-border region.

title: Germany – Risk or hazard assessment for construction – Rahmenvertrag Kampfmittelsondierung
description: Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von Leistungen im Rahmen des Kampfmittelsondierung. Im Zuge von Neubau-, Störungs- und Umlegungsarbeiten werden geplant wie auch ungeplant Bauvorhaben abgewickelt. Sofern langfristig planbar werden Auskünfte zu Kampfmitteln eingeholt und Sondierungen vor Baubeginn durchgeführt. Häufig ist die Sondierung allerdings baubegleitend nötig. Zur Erfüllung der behördlichen Auflagen haben wir bereits seit vielen Jahren mehrere Rahmenvertragspartner unter Vertrag. Für die Abgabe eines Angebots ist die Durchführung eines Teilnahmewettbewerbs zwingend erforderlich.

title: Denmark – Security services – Sikkerhedsscreening og transport af forsendelser
description: Bygningsstyrelsen (herefter "Ordregiver") udbyder som begrænset udbud efter forsvars- og sikkerhedsdirektivet en 3-årig kontrakt om sikkerhedsscreening af forsendelser for eksplosiver, farlige substanser og andet farligt indhold og efterfølgende transport til brugere af ordningen. Forsendelser skal efter screening primært leveres i Hovedstadsområdet, men leverancer vil forekomme til hele Danmark. Brugerne er primært statslige institutioner. Brugerne af ordningen sikrer som udgangspunkt, at forsendelser sendes direkte til screening på screeningscenteret, som er beliggende i postnummer 2770 Kastrup. På screeningscenteret skal leverandøren modtage forsendelser og herefter foretage sikkerhedsscreeningen i henhold til metoder og arbejdsgange defineret af ordregiver. Leverandøren skal som udgangspunkt, medmindre ordregiver tilkøber ad hoc bemanding eller udnytter option på permanent opskalering af bemandingen, bemande screeningscenteret med 2 faste medarbejdere. Ordregiver stiller endvidere materiel til rådighed for leverandøren til brug for screeningen. Overordnet beskrivelse af opgaven og dennes løsning fremgår af nærværende udbudsbekendtgørelse og af det øvrige udbudsmateriale. Endelig beskrivelse af metoder og arbejdsgange for screeningen samt oplysninger om brugerne vil af sikkerhedsmæssige hensyn først blive udleveret til den vindende tilbudsgiver i forbindelse med indgåelse af kontrakt. Leverandøren skal besvare forespørgsler fra brugerne om konkrete forsendelser og skal i begrænset omfang imødekomme brugeres ønsker om hastescreening og -levering. Ved levering skal leverandøren i begrænset omfang transportere forsendelser, som brugerne har modtaget direkte, tilbage til screening på screeningscenteret. Leverandøren skal endvidere efter konkret bestilling fra brugere varetage særkørsler, hvor forsendelser leveres eller afhentes hos Brugerne. Leverandøren skal ligeledes levere følgekørsel med vagt til konkrete forsendelser når Ordregiver eller Brugerne bestiller dette. Aftalen kan forlænges med ét år af gangen i maksimalt fire år. således er aftalens samlede maksimale varighed syv år inkl. de fire forlængelsesoptioner. Der henvises til udbudsmaterialet. Udbudsbetingelserne indeholder en nærmere beskrivelse af opgaven og udbudsforløbet, og det øvrige materiale indeholder en beskrivelse af opgavens omfang. Den anslåede værdi er udtryk for et skøn. Kontraktværdien forventes at blive ca. 54.000.000 kr., ekskl. moms inkl. optioner og en løbetid på syv år.

This Sources Sought notice is issued solely for market research, information, and planning purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10 and DFARS PGI requirements. The parent IDC vehicle (W9127820D0031) expired on December 3, 2025, precluding the issuance of new task orders or out-of-scope modifications under FAR Subpart 16.5. Responders are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this Sources Sought. All costs associated with responding to this notice will be solely at the interested party's expense. Section I - General Overview The 38th Rescue Squadron (RQS) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of providing highly realistic, immersive, and comprehensive pre-deployment Full Mission Profile (FMP) training, including but not limited to Combat Clearance training, Anatomy and Physiology training, live tissue training, scenarios including Mission Planning, Casualty Evacuation (CASEVAC), Technical Rope Rescue, Extrication, Low Visibility operations, Personnel Recovery, Pre Hospital Trauma Life Support or Tactical Combat Casualty Care training. The course must be conducted over an 8-day training course. The objective is to validate and enhance the combat readiness, advanced medical proficiencies, and specialized rescue capabilities of 30+ personnel in preparation for future operational taskings. Contracting Officer: SSgt Samantha Elia, samantha.elia@us.af.mil, 229-257-5588 Contract Specialist: SSgt Landon Docherty, landon.docherty@us.af.mil, 229-257-4739 Response Due date: 08 December 2026 at 9:00 AM, EST. Section II - Requirement The requested services require the contractor to provide an optimal training solution and environment encompassing a continuous 8-day training plan in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW) (attachment 1). Potential sources must be able to meet the following parameters and constraints below and as outlined in the SOO. * Period of Performance: Eight (8) consecutive training days: 31 January - 07 February 2027 (Monday-Sunday). Unlimited working hours allowed, provided flight operations do not exceed 12-hour aircrew duty days. * Place of Performance: The primary training facility must be geographically located within a 10-hour drive of Moody AFB. Locations outside of this range are acceptable but travel costs and time will factor into evaluation criteria in any future solicitation. * Instructor Qualifications: Instructors must possess verified Guardian Angel (GA) or Joint Special Operations Command (JSOC) operational experience. Non-GA instructors must be verifiable SMEs in Pararescue and updated JSOC CQC TTPs. * Tactical / Rescue Ops: Must facilitate CQB/Combat Clearance (per JSOC TTPs), Low Visibility ops, Hostage Rescue, High Angle/Technical Rope Rescue on a dedicated multi-level structure, and complex extrication/structural collapse scenarios. * Medical / Trauma Ops: Must provide Anatomy, Physiology, and fresh/live tissue training utilizing cadavers and AAALAC-compliant live tissue models. Must support advanced surgical procedures, TCCC, and K-9 medical protocols overseen by a qualified ER physician or general surgeon. * Logistics & Equipment: Contractor must provide all non-life-rated extrication tools (Jaws of Life, lift bags, breaching equipment), scenario weapons/simunition (M4 UTM bolts, Glock simunitions), course supplies, and medical resupplies. Note: Government provides life-rated technical rescue gear. * Facility Standards: Must offer a secure, climate-controlled indoor industrial facility capable of day/night, all-weather FMP execution with minimal public visibility. Must include mission planning spaces, gym, secure M4 storage, and high-fidelity helicopter simulators with NVD lighting and sound generation. Section III - Capability Statement Interested parties that possess the capabilities to meet this requirement are requested to submit a Capability Statement. The statement must specifically address the contractor's ability to meet the constraints outlined in the SOW, specifically: * Company Profile: Company Name, CAGE Code, Unique Entity ID (UEI), Business Size/Socioeconomic Status, and Point of Contact information. * Facility Location: Confirmation that the proposed primary training facility is within a 10-hour drive of Moody AFB, alongside a brief description of the facility's structural collapse, vertical, and helicopter simulation capabilities. * Medical & AAALAC Compliance: Evidence of ability to secure cadavers and an active American Association for Accreditation of Laboratory Animal Care (AAALAC) accreditation for live tissue training. * Personnel Qualifications: A summary of the instructor cadre pool demonstrating the required Guardian Angel (GA) or JSOC operational experience and medical oversight credentials. * Logistical Capability: Confirmation of the ability to provide OPFOR, role-players, specific simunitions, and the required non-life-rated tools and medical supplies. Section IV - Submission Instructions All responses to this Sources Sought notice must be submitted electronically via email to the primary point of contacts listed in Section I no later than 9:00 AM, EST on 08 December 2026. title: Z--12750 - BRVB-PARK SIGN REPAIR
description: 12750 - BRVB-PARK SIGN REPAIR PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE: The National Park Service, CONOPS � Central, intends to issue a Request for Quote for the Park Sign Repair project at Brown V Board of Education National Historical Park in Topeka, Kansas. Work will consist of: The National Park Service requires a construction contractor to repair and restore a damaged masonry entrance sign located at Brown v. Board of Education National Historical Park. The existing sign consists of a concrete masonry unit (CMU) core with a brick and limestone facade. Work includes demolition and removal of damaged CMU components; installation of new CMU block, reinforcement, grout, and masonry ties; restoration of the brick facade through salvage and reuse of existing brick where feasible; and procurement and installation of supplemental matching brick necessary to complete the repair. The project also requires fabrication and installation of four replacement precast concrete caps matching the existing profile, color, and texture of the sign. The contractor must provide color and texture samples for National Park Service approval prior to material procurement. Additional work includes installation of appropriate mortar systems, expansion joint materials, anchoring systems, and associated masonry components in accordance with applicable ASTM and industry standards. The contractor shall protect the existing precast signage panels throughout construction and submit proposed means and methods for preserving the panels during restoration activities. The contractor may propose temporary removal and reinstallation of the panels or demonstrate an alternate acceptable approach for completing the masonry restoration while maintaining their protection. The completed work shall restore the structural integrity, appearance, and functionality of the park sign while matching existing architectural features to the greatest extent practicable. SOLICITATION NUMBER: 140PP027Q0054 PROJECT MAGNITUDE: Less than $25,000 TYPE OF CONTRACT: This will be a firm-fixed price contract expected to be awarded to a prime contractor by Winter 2027 with performance to begin in Winter 2027.
